messages:
Ava Patel: Hey folks — informal idea: company softball team this summer? Thinking Tuesday evenings at 6pm. Who's in? :baseball:
Miguel Santos: I’m down! Tuesday works for me. Do we have a field nearby?
Lila Chen: Count me in too. Might be a bit rusty though. :sweat_smile:
Samir Gupta: Love it. Could we do a quick poll for skill level and availability?
Ava Patel: Good call — created a quick Polly (link: https://polly.example.com/softball-signup) — please pick availability and if you want to play OF/IF/P/Bench.
Priya Nair: I can coach snacks and water logistics. Also can bring a portable speaker. :speaker:
Miguel Santos: Suggestion: rotate people each week so folks on PTO or travel don't block a slot.
Lila Chen: Also can we invite partners? maybe keep first few practices Redwood-only to sort rosters.
Samir Gupta: Works for me. Also—anyone with a glove shortage? I can bring an extra one.
Ava Patel: Amazing, thanks Samir & Priya. If anyone wants to be captain or co-captain, volunteer here. I can be co-captain but prefer IF.
Slackbot: Reminder set — "softball signups due" in 3 days (Thu 18:00).
Miguel Santos: Quick Q — is there a budget for jerseys? Could be fun for the demo day.
Priya Nair: I can ask office ops about a small events budget, but probably expect DIY for the first season.
Lila Chen: Ok filled the Polly. Marked myself as "beginner" and Tue/Thu availability.
Samir Gupta: Filled too — prefer catcher or bench.
Ava Patel: Awesome. Next steps: Polly closes Thursday, I’ll post final roster and first practice location Friday. :thumbsup:
Miguel Santos: :+1:
Lila Chen: :raised_hands: 
Priya Nair: Excited!
Samir Gupta: See you on the diamond.
